status: declared before phase implementation, training and candidate queries
hypothesis: Shared king-context hidden features with separate turn-aware middlegame/endgame output heads can represent phase-dependent corrections. Only output architecture changes; default classical evaluation remains.

formats.9: hybrid clipped king-context turn-aware phase output
formats.10: standalone clipped king-context turn-aware phase output

phase: min(24, sum N=1,B=1,R=2,Q=4 for both colors); MG weight phase/24, EG (24-phase)/24; blend signed int64 dots before one integer division

training.initialization: Generate the same 2H control output and RNG state, then clone it into MG and EG; same whole-game split, batches, optimizer and loss. Select each epoch by held-out ordinary loss only.

generation.partitions: first32 pairs phase vs classical30ms, next32 pairs phase vs matched control30ms, last16 pairs conditional phase vs classical100ms. Freeze before candidate opening queries.

verification: Existing tests/formats1..8, independent scalar and Python quantized references, phase-only cache changes, captures/promotions/castling/null/undo, signed-int16 extremes, invalid dimensions/payloads, full rules/protocol verifier and bench7. No move-generation change.

matches.primary: First4 legal UCI ply families, preserve whole color-swapped pairs; primary95% interval includes unresolved0/1 bounds

gate: Always complete both64-game short matches. Long32-game confirmation only if all correctness/tactical gates pass, zero forfeits/unresolved, classical short family lower strictly>50% and control short point>=50% with family lower>=45%. Promotion additionally requires long point>=50%, lower>=45% and zero forfeits/unresolved. No adaptive extension or parameter tuning.
rating: No new Elo calibration in this architecture screen; retain the last exact matched binary's rating. Strength is measured in games, never inferred from teacher error or speed.
limits: One initialization and existing development data isolate architecture, not broad endgame generalization. Broader stable endgame supervision is a separate subsequent experiment. Stockfish superiority unachieved.
